content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education Studies Study organisation Re-registration Dual enrolment Dual enrolment Multiple enrolment means that you are enrolled in two degree programmes at the same time and are working towards a degree in both. This can be done: At the same university → double degree programme At two different universities in Berlin or Brandenburg Please remember: On average, studying at HTW Berlin corresponds to a 40-hour week. So think carefully about whether you can cope with the additional effort. Requirements & restrictions You cannot be enrolled on two NC degree programmes at the same time. If you are admitted to both, you must choose one. Already enrolled in an NC-restricted degree programme? You will only be admitted to the second NC-restricted degree programme if no one is excluded from the first degree programme as a result. Application procedure Regular application for the chosen degree programme within the deadlines . Do not apply for multiple enrolment until you have been admitted. Documents required for enrolment: Declaration on the exercise of membership rights [PDF] You only pay the semester fee at the university at which you exercise your membership rights If membership rights are not exercised at HTW Berlin: Proof of payment of the semester fee at the other university Current certificate of enrolment from the other university Only for multiple enrolment in two Bachelor’s degree programmes: Proof that the Bachelor’s degree programme at the other university is NC-free
